notes.title: Update v1.2.2: Windowed mode enabled
notes.notes:
This update allows to play logiCally in windowed mode.

[u][b]Patch v1.2.2 notes[/b][/u]

[b]Added features[/b]
[list]
[*]Windowed mode enabled.
[*]Results viewing process is now skippable through clicking on window.
[*]Logically icon added.
[/list]

[b]Bugs solved:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a crash when resetting a game under very exceptional circumstances.
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a crash when accesing to a challenge under very exceptional circumstances.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.2.1 notes:
notes.notes:
This patch fixes a problem with game progress when changing profiles immediately after finishing a game.
It also adds some general improvements to the game.

[u][b]Patch 1.2.1 notes:[/b][/u]

[u][b]Bugs:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where a finished game could be re-activated when changing profiles.
[/list]

[u][b]General improvements:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Added a control to adjust the FX volume in the Settings window.
[*]Added a button to close the game mode selection dialog.
[*]Practice mode: The 'Exit' button is now enabled after displaying the result of the challenge.
[*]The 'Accept' button is now hidden when editing a profile to avoid confusion in its use.
[*]Modified the display of errors in the games 'Beams', 'No three', 'Logic path' and 'Dark boxes' to make the first transition smoother.
[*]Modified the display of errors in the game 'Domino' to make it less overwhelming.
[*]The text 'New record' has been replaced by 'New high score'.
[*]In-game help improved in almost all modules (still work in progress).
[/list]

[u][b]Game manual:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]The chapter regarding to the settings dialog has been updated.
[*]The minigame guides have been rearranged to match the order in which games appear in Practice mode.
[*]The name 'Black and White' has been replaced by 'Dark Boxes' to better match game characteristics.
[/list]

notes.title: logiCally v1.2.0 update. New Survival mode.
notes.notes:
With update 1.2.0 a new game mode is added to the logiCally experience: [b]The Survival Mode[/b].

Survival mode is designed for those players who do not want to feel the pressure of time running over their heads.

In this mode the player has unlimited time to solve each challenge. However, a new resource is added: tickets. This new resource must be used carefully in order to overcome the different levels of difficulty.

[b]Game modes:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Timed mode:[/b] Test your skills against the timer.
[*][b]Survival mode:[/b] Solve logical challenges at your own pace.
[*][b]Practice mode:[/b] Improve your skills through randomly generated challenges.
[/list]

Hope you'll enjoy it.



[u][b]Patch 1.2.0 notes:[/b][/u]


[b]Survival mode:[/b]
[list]
[*]New game mode: Survival mode.
[*]New challenge rewards: tickets and rerolls.
[/list]

[b]Timed mode:[/b]
[list]
[*]Stage times have been increased for high levels.
[*]The probability of obtaining time rewards and their value has been slightly increased.
[/list]

[b]Practice mode:[/b]
[list]
[*]Practice mode now generates challenges indefinitely according to the parameters provided.
[*]Added an option to randomly select the type of challenge presented to the player.
[*]Now the player selects between ranges of difficulty levels instead of a specific difficulty level.
[*]The timer has been replaced with information of the difficulty level of the current challenge.
[/list]

[b]Scores:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added separate scoring tables for timed mode and survival mode
[/list]

[b]Game manual:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added an option on the main screen to open the game manual.
[*]Game manual updated to v1.2.0.
[/list]

[b]General:[/b]
[list]
[*]Some transitions between screens improved.
[*]A bug affecting player profiles has been fixed. This bug could cause side effects such as not registering scores or corrupted saved games.
[*]Some help descriptions have been slightly modified.
[*]The graphics of some menus has been modified.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v1.0.2 + Game guide
notes.notes:
An extensive game guide has been added (PDF format).
You can find it in the game folder or through the Steam page.

Patch notes:

[list]
[*]Game guide added
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented the timer from pausing when returning to the main screen by pressing the [ESC] key.
[*]Minor changes in translation.
[/list]
